第9章 她不配难道你配（第1页）
可是潜意识里，何浅晴已经相信了慕迟曜的话。
因为慕迟曜从来都不屑于骗人，更何况是结婚这么重要的事。
慕迟曜不再理她，转身大步的走到办公桌前坐下，屈指敲了敲桌面：“没什么事的话，出去！”
何浅晴看着他，眼眶已经红了，眼看着就要落下眼泪来，楚楚可怜的模样，没有几个男人不会心动。
可慕迟曜却像是有一副铁石心肠一样，不为所动。
“你怎么可以就这么不声不响的结了婚？”何浅晴的大小姐脾气也上来了，质问道，“那个女人是谁？”
“这到底是什么时候的事情，你结婚的事情，怎么都没有一点消息？”
“有必要大张旗鼓？”慕迟曜淡淡的回答，“谁是慕太太，谁可以坐慕太太的位置，不过是我一句话罢了。”
何浅晴狠狠的握住手心，声音里都透出了一股毒辣：“我去查！我就不信，我查不到她是谁！”
“她不配！迟曜，她不配嫁给你，不配做慕太太！”
慕迟曜的眼神骤然一冷：“她不配，难道你配？”
“整个慕城都知道，我何浅晴喜欢你，你却娶了别的女人……”说着说着，何浅晴都要哭出来了。
何浅晴终于哭了出来，一点也没有了刚才的趾高气扬：“迟曜……”
慕迟曜更加烦了，脸色十分难看，眉目间都是戾色：“要哭出去哭。还有，你要是动她一下，别怪我不客气。”
“我的女人，我不护着，难道让别人护？”
他的语气冷冷的，神色只比语气更加冷，何浅晴看了他一眼，哭着转身跑了出去。
慕迟曜立刻收回心思，转而看着办公桌上的文件，认真工作起来。
言安希掐着时间跑进了员工室，换好工作服，打卡上班。
这四年来，她就是这样天天靠打着好几份零工，赚取生活费，和弟弟的医药费。
虽然，她今天已经嫁给了慕城最有权势最有钱的男人，她依然还是要来打工。
言安希一边扎起头发一边嘟囔：“慕迟曜这个男人真的是太小气了，我都已经是他的人了，他居然……啊！”
她不知道是撞到了谁，只感觉右手手臂整个被烫到了，火辣辣的，像是脱了一层皮似的。雪白娇嫩的肌肤上，瞬间就红了一大片。
“言安希，你走路是不是不长眼睛？撞到了客人的咖啡，你赔得起吗？”
言安希还来不及惊叫，旁边已经有一道尖锐又刻薄的女声传来，带着讽刺，态度恶劣。
她抬头看去，是和她一起在这里打工的同班同学，李韵。
言安希虽然性格好脾气好，但也不是好惹的，任人欺负揉捏，她立刻反驳：“到底是我走路不长眼睛还是你走路不长眼睛？我们去找店长，调监控好好看看！”
李韵一下子被她吼得怔住了，如果真的要调监控的话，那自己……肯定是理亏的那一个。

Chapter 9 She doesn’t deserve it, do you? (Page 1)
But subconsciously, He Qianqing already believed Mu Chi Yao's words.
Because Mu Chi Yao never bothered to lie to others, let alone something as important as marriage.
Mu Chi Yao ignored her, turned around, strode to the desk and sat down, tapping the table with his fingers: "If there's nothing else, get out!"
He Qianqing looked at him, her eyes were already red, and she was about to shed tears. She looked so pitiful that few men would not be moved.
But Mu Chi Yao seemed to have a heart of stone and remained unmoved.
"How could you get married so quietly?" He Qianqing's eldest daughter also became angry and asked, "Who is that woman?"
"When did this happen? Why is there no news about your marriage?"
"Is it necessary to make a big show of it?" Mu Chi Yao replied calmly, "Who is Mrs. Mu and who can sit in Mrs. Mu's position is just a word from me."
He Qianqing held her hand fiercely, with a hint of venom in her voice: "I'll check it out! I don't believe it, I can't find out who she is!"
"She doesn't deserve it! Chi Yao, she doesn't deserve to marry you, she doesn't deserve to be Mrs. Mu!"
Mu Chi Yao's eyes suddenly turned cold: "She doesn't deserve it, do you?"
"Everyone in Mucheng knows that I, He Qianqing, likes you, but you married another woman..." He Qianqing was about to cry as he spoke.
He Qianqing finally cried, without any of the arrogance she had just now: "Chi Yao..."
Mu Chi Yao became even more annoyed, his face was very ugly, and his brows were full of anger: "Cry out and cry. Also, if you touch her, don't blame me for being rude."
"If I don't protect my woman, how can I let others protect her?"
His tone was cold, and his expression was colder than his tone. He Qianqing glanced at him, turned around and ran out crying.
Mu Chi Yao immediately retracted his thoughts, turned to look at the documents on his desk, and started working seriously.
Yan Anxi took the time to run into the staff room, changed into work clothes, and clocked in to work.
For the past four years, she has been working several odd jobs every day to earn living expenses and her brother's medical expenses.
Although she is married to the most powerful and wealthy man in Mucheng today, she still has to work.
Yan Anxi muttered while tying up her hair: "This man Mu Chi Yao is really too stingy. I am already his, but he actually... ah!"
She didn't know who she bumped into, but she felt that her entire right arm had been burned, as if a layer of skin had been peeled off. The snow-white and delicate skin suddenly turned red.
"Yan Anxi, don't you have eyes when you walk? Can you afford to pay for bumping into a customer's coffee?"
Before Yan Anxi could scream, a sharp and mean female voice came from the side, with sarcasm and a bad attitude.
She looked up and saw her classmate Li Yun who was working here together.
Although Yan Anxi is good-tempered and good-tempered, she is not someone to be trifled with. She allows others to bully and knead her. She immediately retorted: "Is it because I don't have eyes when I walk or because you don't have eyes when you walk? Let's go find the store manager and adjust the monitoring to take a closer look!"
Li Yun was stunned by her yelling. If the surveillance was really going to be adjusted, then he... would definitely be the one at fault.
